header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners; nor intimation received.
body: This Petition was filed in year 2016 and was lastly fixed in court on 27-08-2024 when none was present on behalf of the petitioners and it was observed that if on next date of hearing none appears on behalf of the petitioners appropriate orders including dismissal of petition would be passed without providing further opportunity. Today none has appeared on behalf of petitioners, which reflects that petitioners and their counsel have lost interest to pursue instant petition, therefore, same alongwith pending listed application stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
